lineNumber.description: The line number of start of the statement.

comment.description: Single-line comment text on the same line as the statement.

kind.description:
Kind of assignment:
 - *SIMPLE** is a normal assignment: `a = ...`
 - **ARRAY** is array destructuring: `[a, b] = ...`
 - **OBJECT** is object destructuring: `{a, b} = ...`

vars.description:
The variable names to assign. Normally this is a single variable for a simple assignment, but there could be
more than one for a destructuring assignment; see #kind.

expr.description: The expression that produces the value.

title:
An assignment statement sets the value of one or more local variables. This supports simple assignment a well as
array destructuring assignment, with or without an explicit `var` or `let` keyword. Object destructuring is _not_
currently supported because there is no Python equivalent.

Note that assignment statements using property get (`o.x`) or element get (`a[0]`) become
{@link TestScript.AssertExpr} statements since they don't introduce new variables.
name: TestScript.Assignment
